title: ThunderstormInfo
description: Information about the Thunderstorm service instance, including version details, configuration, and license information.

arguments.description: Command-line arguments used to start the underlying THOR instance.

license_expiration.description: Expiration date and time of the license in ISO 8601 format.

scan_speed_limitation.description: Scan speed limitation in bytes per second. A value of 0 indicates no limitation.

threads.description: Number of threads used for scanning.

ThunderstormVersionInfo.description: Version information for various components of the Thunderstorm service.

thor.description: Version of the THOR scanner engine.

build.description: Build timestamp of the THOR scanner.

sigma.description: Version identifier of the Sigma rules.
